text:
Aria Gomez: Quick heads-up from this morning's vendor call: H100 firmware candidate regressed on long-context attention (edge cases > 8192). Need to decide marketplace phasing and partner comms.
Noah Rivera: Is this correctness or perf?
Priya Nair: Vendor says it's a perf tail-latency issue in the attention kernel, not data corruption. They pushed a reproducer to the ticket.
Ben Holt: Given that, my recommendation: 1) promote Gaudi as GA in both EU/US on 04/28, 2) put H100 behind a pilot tag and 3) make H200 the recommended fallback tile.
Aria Gomez: Agree. Also SIs asked about SDK changes for H200 memory layout. We'll need a short migration diff and a 48-72h heads-up before promote.
Noah Rivera: Region capacity check: can we support H200-heavy routing? eu-west is light on H200, so advertise gaudi fallback in EU.
PartnerBot: Vendor note posted: https://partners.example.com/notes/PRJ-7890 ":warning:"
Priya Nair: Proposed rollout windows:
- Wave 1 (04/28): Gaudi stable + B200 economy tile
- Wave 2 (05/06): H200 recommended + H100 pilot if FW hotfix lands by 04/30
- MI300: remain preview until driver 1.3.1 fixes JIT hangs
Ben Holt: Add clear rollback triggers in partner brief: P99 latency > 2x baseline OR error spike > 0.5% over 30m -> immediate rollback to fallback tag. Also KV cache miss rate > 10% must trigger investigation.
Aria Gomez: Action items: @Priya to draft partner pre-promote brief (include rollback criteria, routing snippet, SI migration diff) by EOD 04/24. @Noah to run H200 & Gaudi canaries tomorrow. @Ben to assemble region capacity map.
Noah Rivera: Canary manifest example pushed to runbook:
```
image: registry.redwood.ai/gaudi:2024-04-24-canary
tests:
  - latency_p99
  - kv_cache_warmup
  - quant_consistency
```
PartnerBot: SI partners requested 72h notice before any promote and a sample client patch for H200 memory layout.
Priya Nair: Draft brief uploaded: https://docs.redwood.ai/partnerships/pre-promote-brief-0424. Includes routing policy examples and rollback rules.
Noah Rivera: Gaudi canary results: 4/4 green. H200 canary: 3/4 passed, quant_consistency failed on quantized MLP path (ticket filed).
Ben Holt: Given results, proceed with Wave 1 (Gaudi + B200). Hold Wave 2 signoff pending H200 quant fix and H100 FW candidate stabilization.
Aria Gomez: I'll schedule an internal signoff on 04/29 (partners + comms + legal). If vendor confirms FW hotfix by 04/30 and canaries green by 05/01, we target 05/06 promote.
Priya Nair: Noted. I'll include an SI FAQ about expected perf deltas on quantized kernels.
Noah Rivera: Re-running H200 canary after vendor patch. Will update logs here.
PartnerBot: Reminder set: 04/30 10:00 vendor final candidate review meeting. :calendar:
Aria Gomez: Thanks team. Closing thread; will reopen if vendor ETA changes.
